clue.text: Try to capture last of men, clearing the country

indicators.note: one piece takes others prisoner, so they sit inside it

parts.note: to have a try at something is to have a bash

indicators.note: only the final letter of the word men is used

parts.note: a glade is an open clearing in a wood

explanation.surface: Someone attempts to round up the last men before the nation is evacuated.
explanation.definitionFit: Bangladesh is a nation of South Asia, so it is an example of a country.

clue.text: Supporter married to club

indicators.note: clubbing something is beating it about, so the letters of married are knocked into a new order

explanation.surface: A fan who has wed someone from the golf club.
explanation.definitionFit: An admirer is a fan or follower, someone who supports a person or team.

clue.text: Good intense feeling — one has a hand in it

definitions.text: one has a hand in it

parts.note: love is a strong, deep feeling of affection

explanation.surface: A fine passion that grips whoever is involved.
explanation.definitionFit: Clothing worn on the hand: whoever wears one literally has their hand inside it.

clue.text: I'd slipped into grave, perhaps — by this?

definitions.text: I'd slipped into grave, perhaps — by this?

indicators.note: one piece is slid inside another, sitting within it

parts.note: a grave is one kind of accent mark over a letter, so the perhaps signals an example
taken as its letters without the apostrophe

explanation.surface: A dark reflection on how someone might end up in their grave.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue does double duty: a mishap is how one might end up in a grave, and the grave mark is one sort of the word the pieces build.
explanation.definitionFit: A mishap or unplanned misfortune is just the sort of thing that could send someone to an early grave.

clue.text: Roving cameraman with kilt on almost stealing kiss!

definitions.text: Roving cameraman with kilt on almost stealing kiss!

indicators.note: the anagrammed letters take in another piece, holding it within
wandering about, so the letters of the fodder move into a new order
the word on loses its final letter

parts.note: X is the symbol for a kiss at the end of a letter

explanation.surface: A wandering photographer in a kilt sneaks a kiss, to everyone's surprise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Roving' shuffles the cameraman and kilt with O, the first letter of 'on' after 'almost' trims it; 'stealing' then holds the kiss. The clue ends on the very mark it defines.
explanation.definitionFit: The final punctuation of the clue is the symbol in question, and the antics described are worthy of one.

clue.text: Out loud, call girl a smoker

indicators.note: spoken rather than written, so the word for call girl is heard as another word

parts.note: a hooker is slang for a prostitute

explanation.surface: Ringing up a woman of the night who happens to be a smoker.
explanation.walkthrough: The two words sound alike in non-rhotic British speech, where the final R of the slang word is not sounded.
explanation.definitionFit: A water pipe used for smoking tobacco, so a device one smokes with.

clue.text: Party where warrior goes topless

indicators.note: losing its top means the first letter is dropped

parts.note: a brave is a Native American warrior

explanation.surface: A party where a fighter strips to the waist.
explanation.definitionFit: A rave is a large dance party, usually with electronic music.

clue.text: Copy plate with rice for cooking

indicators.note: cooked food is altered, so the letters of these words are mixed up

explanation.surface: Serve rice the same way on a plate, ready to cook.
explanation.definitionFit: To replicate something is to reproduce it exactly, making a duplicate.

clue.text: Nothing in a private chamber that's brought up is simple

indicators.note: one piece sits inside another
in a down entry, bringing up means the letters run upwards, so they are read backwards

parts.note: lav is short for lavatory, a private room
nil means nothing, zero

explanation.surface: Something reported from a private room turns out to be plain.
explanation.definitionFit: Plain or ordinary, as in a vanilla version of a product with no extras.

clue.text: Shot pig trimmed

indicators.note: trimming cuts both ends off the word

parts.note: gammon is cured meat from a pig's hind leg

explanation.surface: A pig has been shot and dressed.
explanation.definitionFit: Shot is ammunition, and ammo is the informal short form of that word.

clue.text: Grower putting bananas before beer

indicators.note: the first piece is placed in front of the second

parts.note: both words are slang for crazy
a pint is a measure of beer

explanation.surface: A farmer is put ahead of drinking by a love of bananas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Grower' is anything that grows: here a wild plant, also called lords-and-ladies.
explanation.definitionFit: The cuckoopint is a wild arum plant, and a plant is something that grows.

clue.text: Intimate relationship initially breaking the Devil

indicators.note: breaking into something, a letter lodges inside it

parts.note: the Fiend is a name for Satan

indicators.note: only the first letter of relationship is taken

explanation.surface: A close affair at first gets in the way of a devilish figure.
explanation.definitionFit: As a noun, an intimate is a close companion or confidant.

clue.text: A stream passing through old communist city in Texas

indicators.note: running through the middle of something, so one piece sits inside another

parts.note: Mao Zedong was the founding communist leader of China
a rill is a small stream

explanation.surface: A brook flows through a Texan city linked to a Chinese revolutionary.
explanation.definitionFit: Amarillo is a city in the Texas Panhandle.

clue.text: Country state with slight following in South Africa

indicators.note: the pieces are placed inside another
the second piece comes after the first

parts.note: RI is the abbreviation for Rhode Island, a US state
lank can mean lean or thin, slight in build

explanation.surface: A nation's condition, with a minor snub that follows on in South Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: Sri Lanka is an island nation off the south of India.

clue.text: Desperate act, this heartless lad at fault

indicators.note: being faulty, the letters are in the wrong order and need rearranging
the middle letter of lad is removed

explanation.surface: A frantic move by a cruel young man who is to blame.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Desperate act' reads as the definition, but 'act' belongs to the fodder; 'heartless' turns LAD into LD.
explanation.definitionFit: A last-ditch effort is a final desperate attempt to avert defeat.

clue.text: Open a drink

parts.note: a jar is British slang for a drink, especially a pint of beer

explanation.surface: Uncork a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A door left ajar is slightly open.

clue.text: Husband hoarding silver on track for brutality

indicators.note: in a down entry, a piece placed on another sits above it, so first
storing something away inside, so one piece holds another

parts.note: to husband resources is to save them
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
RY is short for railway, a track

explanation.surface: A spouse stashing silver on a railway line, all for the sake of cruelty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Husband' looks like a man but is the verb meaning to conserve.
explanation.definitionFit: Savagery is fierce cruelty or violence, which is brutality.

clue.text: God in time of difficulty not given credit

indicators.note: this piece is withheld, so it is taken out

parts.note: a crisis is a time of serious trouble
CR is the accounting abbreviation for credit

explanation.surface: A deity in hard times is refused a loan.
explanation.definitionFit: Isis was an Egyptian goddess, a divine figure of mythology.

clue.text: Casual massaging around soft bone

indicators.note: the anagrammed letters go round another letter
kneading moves things around, so the letters of casual are reworked

parts.note: p is the musical abbreviation for piano, softly

explanation.surface: A relaxed rubdown working over a tender bone.
explanation.definitionFit: The scapula is the shoulder blade, a bone of the upper back.

clue.text: One assumes processing is ready, having article to collect

indicators.note: the shuffled letters gather another piece inside them
processing works material over, so the letters of is and ready are rearranged

parts.note: a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: An official notes that the paperwork is ready and there is an item to pick up.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means I suppose, an expression of assumption by the speaker.

clue.text: In general, a goal that's incomplete must inspire learner

indicators.note: to inspire is to breathe in, so the piece takes the other within
the word loses its final letter

parts.note: a target is an aim or goal
L is for learner, as on British learner-driver plates

explanation.surface: Broadly speaking, an unmet objective should motivate a student.
explanation.definitionFit: As in the public at large, the phrase means taken as a whole, generally.

clue.text: Some bananas, perhaps, about right for meal

indicators.note: the outer piece goes around another

parts.note: bananas come in a bunch; perhaps marks it as one example of a bunch

explanation.surface: Fruit served as a late-morning meal.
explanation.definitionFit: Brunch is a meal combining breakfast and lunch.

clue.text: Chinese fruit

definitions.meaning: the standard spoken language of China, as a noun
a small citrus fruit, similar to a tangerine

explanation.definitionFit: Both the main Chinese language and a small orange share this name.

clue.text: A bulge on top

parts.note: a swell is a rounded rise or bulge

explanation.surface: A lump appears on the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: On top in the sense of in addition, besides, also.

clue.text: Mad king in Texas city

indicators.note: one piece goes inside another

parts.note: Waco is a city in central Texas
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A crazy monarch in a Texan town.
explanation.definitionFit: Wacko is slang for crazy or eccentric.

clue.text: Man takes luggage as a precaution

parts.note: Justin is a man's name
a case is a suitcase, an item of luggage

explanation.surface: A fellow grabs his bags, just to be safe.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something in case of trouble is taking a precaution against it.

clue.text: One stops for Irish city

definitions.meaning: a stopper or bung for a bottle
a city in the south of the Republic of Ireland

explanation.definitionFit: Both a bottle stopper and a city in southern Ireland have this name.

clue.text: Could hospital have been clean?

indicators.note: could suggests something else possible, so the letters may be rearranged

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hospital, as on road signs
was is a past form of be

explanation.surface: Might the hospital have been spotless?
explanation.walkthrough: The clue gives the hospital first and the past tense second, so the pieces must be reordered; 'Could' is the only word left to signal that.
explanation.definitionFit: To wash something is to clean it with water.

clue.text: Important drink imported by Scottish island for dance

indicators.note: brought into, so the pieces sit inside another

parts.note: Hoy is one of the Orkney Islands off northern Scotland
key means crucial or important
Coke is a cola drink

explanation.surface: A vital soft drink brought in by islanders for a jig.
explanation.walkthrough: The hokey cokey is a British party dance, the same as the American hokey pokey.
explanation.definitionFit: A participation dance with a sung chorus, popular at British parties.
